channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.title: With less than 100 days left until Election Day, how the midterms are shaping up
item.description: There are now fewer than 100 days until Election Day in November. Here's how NPR's Mara Liasson sees the midterm campaign shaping up.

item.description: One suspect is in custody following a mass shooting at a Seattle food festival on Sunday that left three victims dead and four others injured.
